incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created — runtime:gpu pool high error rate (CUDA OOM) on gpu-node-17. Severity: P1. Paging enabled. Pager: @Alex

Alex: noticing a bunch of `CUDA out of memory` traces from serving-runtime. headroom reports ~2.1GB but alloc fails immediately on new requests.

Maya: can you paste the error block? also which model and quantization?

Alex: model=rwkv-13b-q5, batch size 1, quantized. logs:
```
E (serving) allocation failed: cudaErrorOutOfMemory: out of memory
stack: runtime/allocator.cc:443 allocate_reserved_block
kv-cache reserved: 512MB, headroom reported: 2200MB
node: gpu-node-17, container: runtime-7df9
```

James: interesting — headroom vs realtime allocation mismatch suggests fragmentation or pinned reservation mismatch. Did we recently land the reserve-pinning change?

Alex: yes, node has the new reserve pinning patch from last deploy (spare-reserve pinned to prevent reclaim races).

Maya: timeline: spikes started ~02:03 UTC, node started sporadic OOMs at 02:06. Some containers restarted by kube. Traffic observed 502/503s to a small subset of customers.

Lin: customer-ops: impacted customers list (first-pass): cust-eta, cust-ursa. We're drafting an advisory. Latency is also increasing for queued requests.

Ryan: quick checks — `nvidia-smi` shows GPU memory 95% with lots of small allocations. `pmap` shows large number of allocations with many small free fragments. Page fault rates up.

James: can you check reserved block accounting? run:
```bash
cat /sys/devices/gpu0/reserve_stats
# or runtime tool: ./bin/reservectl --node gpu-node-17 status
```

Alex: reservectl output:
```
reserved_total=2048MB
reserved_used=1600MB
spare_pool=256MB (pinned)
free_contiguous=120MB
"largest_free_chunk"=96MB
fragmentation_ratio=0.62
```

Maya: that matches symptoms — there's logical headroom (reserved can be counted) but no contiguous block for the new allocation, so alloc fails. pinned spare prevents coalescing.

James: mitigation options (short term):
- relax reserve pinning (unpin spare_pool) on the node
- drain node and restart runtime to compact allocations
- route traffic away from this AZ for affected customers
- fall back to q4model variant for heavy tenants (lower mem)

Alex: I'm going to pause accepting new inflight requests to runtime-7df9 and set route-policy to fallback for cust-eta and cust-ursa.

Lin: pushing customer advisory draft now. Notifying affected customers with ETA 30m for mitigation.

Ryan: I'm running unpin step now (one-shot): `reservectl --node gpu-node-17 unpin-spare` — doing a rolling restart of container afterwards.

James: be careful — unpin can make reclaim races worse if not combined with short drain. Plan: mark node cordoned, migrate pods, restart runtime process so allocator rebuilds contiguous free.

Alex: doing cordon + drain for gpu-node-17. Recreating pods on another node.

incident-bot: action log: @Alex cordoned node gpu-node-17 at 02:18 UTC; @Ryan unpinned spare_pool; restart requested for runtime-7df9.

Maya: after restart, monitor fragmentation metrics: `allocator.contiguous_chunks` and `kvcache.reserved_hits`. Also watch `oom_count` for the node.

Ryan: restart complete, runtime came back up. Early checks: contiguous free chunk increased to 1.2GB. No further OOMs in 6m.

Alex: routing restored for affected customers. Latency back to baseline for routed traffic. No additional restarts.

Lin: emailed impacted customers with mitigation summary and temporary degradation note. Will follow up with postmortem once we have root cause.

James: dev action items:
- revert aggressive reserve-pinning until we have defragmentation strategy
- add allocator metric for "largest_free_chunk" per-node and SLO alerts
- add automatic fallback to q4 models for high-fragmentation nodes

Maya: handing off follow-up to @Maya (next shift) for root-cause writeup and postmortem.

Alex: thanks all. marking incident resolved for now. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident resolved at 02:32 UTC. Postmortem required — assigned to Maya. Link: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/1895678901>
